instruction: Look at `amp1.sch`, duplicate the placed `U1` / `R1` / `C1` component group on the same sheet; copy the three components only and leave the existing nets unchanged, and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch`. For this task, start EAGLE from `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` and open `amp1.sch` there. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.sch` must parse as EAGLE XML. 2. It must contain exactly 6 `<part>` elements. 3. The original `U1`, `R1`, and `C1` must remain present. 4. Each of `U1`, `R1`, and `C1` must have at least one duplicate whose refdes follows EAGLE's rename pattern, such as `U1_1` or `U2`. 5. Every duplicate must also be placed on the sheet via an `<instance>` element.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(8); w, h = pyautogui.size(); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 100, h/2 + 25); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 213, h/2 + 146); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 - 80, h/2 + 68); time.sleep(5)
